_comment: form_disqualifiers for the DV packet: the combinations of answers that rule a filer out, or that make an order unavailable to them. A court form does not only ask questions, it also says when the answers disqualify - and nothing in a field list records that. Each entry here becomes an alert node in the flowchart, with one arrow per condition; run `node pipeline-disqualifiers.js --check` to see which are wired up. Found by `--scan`, which reads the PDFs for sentences of the form 'you do not qualify unless', 'only if you', 'you must be'.

disqualifiers.message: You do not qualify for this kind of restraining order unless you checked one of the other relationships listed above.
disqualifiers.source: If no, you do not qualify for this kind of restraining order unless you checked one of the other relationships listed above.
disqualifiers._note: The gate lives inside the relationship question - it is only asked because 'We live together or used to live together' was ticked - so 'nothing is answered here' is never true and cannot be the condition. What disqualifies is that none of the other six is ticked, which is six isNot conditions.
